name: ag-remote
description: Control your Antigravity agent from your phone: approve or deny commands, send prompts and screenshots, stop runs and get notified, on any network with end-to-end encryption.
author: Dr. Shubham Kashyap

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --external:vscode --minify --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/extension.cjs && esbuild bin/ag-remote.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=dist/cli.mjs && npm run build:pwa
scripts.test: npm run test:ls && npm run test:multi && npm run test:adapter && npm run test:server && npm run test:hub && npm run test:pwa && npm run test:pairing && npm run test:audit && npm run test:env && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:relay-host
scripts.build:pwa: esbuild src/pwa/app.js src/pwa/e2e.js src/pwa/relay-link.js src/pwa/sw.js src/pwa/app.css --minify --legal-comments=none --outdir=dist/pwa && node -e "for (const f of ['index.html', 'manifest.json']) require('fs').copyFileSync('src/pwa/' + f, 'dist/pwa/' + f)"

commands.title: Antigravity Remote: Show Pairing QR Code

agRemote.port.description: Port on which the local remote server listens.

agRemote.host.description: Host address for the server (default: 0.0.0.0 for local Wi-Fi and Tailscale reachability).

enumDescriptions: Relay for any network, plus direct Wi-Fi/Tailscale with a PIN
Only direct Wi-Fi/Tailscale with a PIN (nothing goes through the relay)
Only the relay; the local server accepts this PC only
agRemote.transport.description: How your phone reaches this PC. The relay is end-to-end encrypted: it forwards messages it cannot read.

agRemote.relayUrl.description: Hosted relay used when transport is "both" or "relay".
